prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1031; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving your insured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm whether a claim has been opened and provide the claim number and the name of the assigned adjuster.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the insured's vehicle and any repair records, photographs, recorded statements, dashcam or telematics data, the claim file, and all communications with the insured or any third party. Any destruction or alteration of such material may result in sanctions.

We look forward to your prompt written response. Until we hear from you, we ask that no settlement offers or statements be made to our client.
